verdict: Costco closed its fiscal year with profit up 9% to $2.35B — net sales rose only 1.0% because the quarter had one week fewer than a year ago, while comparable sales climbed 5.4% and e-commerce jumped 18.9%.

segments.name: Net sales
segments.note: Everything sold in the warehouses and online — the +1.0% compares a 16-week quarter with a 17-week quarter a year ago; comparable sales rose 5.4%.

segments.name: Membership fees
segments.note: Annual fees from members — almost pure profit, since the warehouses would run anyway.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Warehouse labor, rent, utilities and head office.

otherDetail: Interest income and other of $120M, less $49M of interest expense.
footerNote: Costco's merchandise costs include buying, freight and shrink (lost or damaged goods) — the direct cost of what's on the shelves. The quarter is 16 weeks, ended September 1, 2024; the year-ago quarter had 17 weeks.
follow100Note: Membership fees supplied $1.90 of every $100 of revenue — and because they carry almost no direct cost, they account for roughly half of Costco's operating profit.

takeaways.title: Comps tell the real story
takeaways.text: Comparable sales rose 5.4% (6.9% excluding gasoline prices and currency moves) — the headline +1.0% for net sales compares a 16-week quarter with the 17-week quarter a year ago. E-commerce comparable sales jumped 18.9%.

takeaways.title: Membership fees, nearly pure profit
takeaways.text: Membership fees were $1,512M, almost unchanged from $1,509M a year ago. They arrive with almost no direct cost attached, so without them the quarter's $3,042M of operating income would have been roughly half as big.

takeaways.title: A record year, with a tax gift
takeaways.text: Quarterly net income rose 9.0% to $2,354M, and full-year net income reached $7,367M ($16.56 per share). The quarter's profit included a $63M one-off tax benefit, and Costco closed the year with 891 warehouses.

oneTimers: A net non-recurring tax benefit of $63M ($0.14 per diluted share), from a transfer pricing settlement and true-ups of tax reserves — it flatters this quarter's profit and tax rate slightly.
